title: How to enlarge cursor in Canva on Mac: system settings for better visibility
metaTitle: How to enlarge cursor in Canva on Mac: Step by Step
description: Learn how to enlarge cursor in Canva on Mac by adjusting your system settings. Follow our guide to improve visibility while designing in the Canva app.
intro: You cannot change the cursor size inside the Canva application settings. To enlarge your cursor while using Canva on a Mac, you must adjust the global pointer settings in your macOS System Settings.
tldr: Open System Settings on your Mac.
Navigate to Accessibility and then Display.
Adjust the Pointer size slider to your preference.
This change applies globally to all apps, including Canva.

stats.label: U.S. adults living with a disability

blocks.text: Why you cannot change the cursor inside Canva

Canva operates as a web-based platform even when you install the dedicated desktop application on your Mac. Because of this architecture, the application does not manage mouse or trackpad behavior independently. It relies entirely on the underlying operating system to define how the cursor looks, how fast it moves, and how large it appears. Many users look for a setting within the Canva editor menu, but you will not find one because it does not exist.

This design choice keeps the application lightweight and consistent across different browsers and operating systems. If you find your cursor difficult to track against a busy background in your design, you must make a system-wide adjustment. This change will affect every application you use on your Mac, not just Canva. It is a common practice for designers who spend long hours working on intricate details and need better visual feedback from their pointing device.
Steps to enlarge your cursor on macOS
Follow these steps to modify your pointer size. These instructions apply to macOS Sonoma, Ventura, and all recent versions of the operating system.

items: Click the Apple Menu icon in the top-left corner of your display.
Select System Settings from the drop-down menu.
Click the Accessibility tab located in the sidebar on the left.
Select the Display option from the list of accessibility features.
Locate the Pointer section by scrolling down if necessary.
Drag the Pointer size slider to the right to increase the size of your cursor.
Adjust the Pointer outline color or Pointer fill color to increase contrast if needed.

blocks.text: Sometimes a larger cursor is not enough to help you work comfortably. If you struggle to locate your pointer quickly, you can enable the shake to locate feature. When this is active, moving your mouse or trackpad rapidly will cause the cursor to grow significantly in size for a brief moment. This is helpful when you have multiple monitors or a very large display where the cursor often gets lost.

Another common issue is confusing the cursor size with the zoom level of the Canva editor itself. If the text, buttons, and icons in Canva appear too small, you should check your browser zoom level. Press Command and the plus key to zoom in, or Command and the minus key to zoom out. A zoom level of 100 percent is the standard baseline. If you find yourself constantly zooming, consider using the full-screen mode in the Canva desktop app to remove browser clutter.

Users sometimes report that the entire Canva interface seems distorted or tiny. This is rarely a cursor issue. Instead, it often relates to high-resolution display scaling settings in macOS. If your screen resolution is set to a very high value, the interface elements might appear smaller than intended. You can check this by going to System Settings, clicking Displays, and verifying your resolution settings.

If the problem persists only in the Canva desktop app, you may need to clear the application cache. You can do this by resetting the app through the settings menu or by restarting the application entirely. Ensure you are running the latest version of the app by checking the App Store or the official Canva website. Updates often include fixes for display rendering issues that might mimic cursor or interface problems.

faq.question: Can I change the cursor only for Canva?
faq.answer: No, macOS does not allow you to set different cursor sizes for individual applications. Changes made in System Settings will affect all apps.

faq.question: Will a larger cursor affect my design precision?
faq.answer: A very large cursor can sometimes make it harder to select small elements or align objects precisely. If you increase the size significantly, you may need to zoom in closer on your design to maintain accuracy.

faq.question: How do I make the cursor return to normal?
faq.answer: Return to System Settings, navigate to Accessibility, then Display, and move the Pointer size slider back to the leftmost position.

steps.name: Open System Settings
steps.text: Click the Apple menu in the top-left corner of your screen and select System Settings.

steps.name: Navigate to Accessibility
steps.text: In the sidebar, click on Accessibility to view your display and input options.

steps.name: Adjust Pointer Size
steps.text: Click on Display, then find the Pointer section and move the slider to your preferred size.

troubleshooting.fix: Check your browser or app zoom level by pressing ⌘ + 0 to reset to 100 percent.
